scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: How should the Google Quantum AI verifiable-compilation evaluation principles be adapted into an honest acceptance standard for logical-memory and QEC resource claims?

relevant_rules: verify a submission before scoring it
score each task by reference cost divided by candidate cost
combine task improvements using a geometric mean
use task-specific cost functions rather than one universal proxy
derive challenge inputs from a salted SHA-256 submission hash
use a one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper failure bound at confidence 1-2^-128
include approximation error in the cost only when the algorithm can operationally pay that penalty
treat logical qubit and Toffoli counts as coarse proxies rather than physical QEC cost

not_copied.reason: they score fault-tolerant application subroutines, not a physical logical-memory experiment
a rejected DQI sample can be rerun, but failure of a stored unknown quantum state cannot be repaired by repeating the memory experiment
the scoped QEC verifier has two mandatory tasks, X memory and Z memory, at the same physical conditions

strict_reference_experiment.challenge_seed_derivation: lower 63 bits of the first eight SHA-256 bytes of UTF8(salt) || 0x00 || canonical Stim circuit bytes

qec_verification_gate.correctness_before_cost: both X and Z one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bounds must be <=0.01 at exactly 1,000 rounds and identical physical conditions
qec_verification_gate.decoder_timing: must be reported; local batch timing is diagnostic and cannot satisfy a hardware deadline gate
qec_verification_gate.drift_correlation_gate: required before #023 scalable-memory readiness or B7 credit, but not supplied by this iid circuit-level reference run

qec_cost_and_score.reference_cost: the strict distance-7 surface-code reference cost after both bases pass verification
qec_cost_and_score.composite_score: Score_QEC = sqrt(I_X * I_Z) after both bases verify; otherwise Score_QEC=0
qec_cost_and_score.candidate_acceptance: Score_QEC >=1.25, I_X>=1, I_Z>=1, both strict verification gates pass, and no noise, decoder, connectivity, horizon, or confidence assumption is weakened
qec_cost_and_score.why_no_repetition_factor: memory failure destroys the stored-state instance; unlike DQI, independent reruns do not operationally recover the same unknown state

promotion_ladder.exploratory: 95 percent Wilson analysis may guide experiment selection but earns no strict acceptance credit
promotion_ladder.strict_1k_reference: both bases pass the 1-2^-128 Clopper-Pearson gate at 1,000 rounds; normalized reference score becomes 1.0
promotion_ladder.b2_candidate_credit: a same-condition candidate strictly verifies and earns Score_QEC>=1.25 without per-basis regression
promotion_ladder.p023_scalable_memory: strict one-million-round X/Z evidence plus drift/correlation stress and declared decoder deadline
promotion_ladder.b7_resource_credit: P023 and B2 gates pass and calibrated architecture evidence accepts the dependency
